Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: In Step 2, the Planner identified Norris Bradbury as the likely answer to the question, incorrectly stating that he directed Los Alamos (Project Y) and oversaw the assembly of the first atomic device (Trinity). This is factually incorrect because J. Robert Oppenheimer was the scientific director of the Manhattan Project at Los Alamos (Project Y), where the first atomic bomb was developed. Norris Bradbury succeeded Oppenheimer as the director of Los Alamos after the war, but he did not direct the project during the development of the first atomic bomb. This misstep led to subsequent confusion and unnecessary searches to validate the incorrect hypothesis about Bradbury, rather than focusing on Oppenheimer from the start.
